title: What the browser UI kit is, and where it runs
summary: packages/oorexx_browser_ui_kit (v0.1 accepted; v0.2 submitted 15 Nov 2026) drives the claude.ai and chatgpt.com pages from native ooRexx over the Chrome DevTools protocol, on signed-in browser profiles that Tom hands over himself. It runs on Tom's workstation (the machine that also runs the Rasen Falcon mailbox), in his copy ~/alchemy-autobuild/browser_ui_kit, not in the Autobuild checkout. Three uses: ALCHEMYFETCH (fetches allowlisted documents for agents), the mail nudger (tells a chat it has mail), and browser-ui.rex (state, conversations, send, capture, nudge, mail).
invariants: It is Tom's machine: an agent asks through Rasen Falcon (ALCHEMYFETCH) or is nudged; it never runs the kit itself.
v0.2 is a candidate until its Autobuild receipt says PASS; v0.1 stays accepted and unchanged.
